public.goal: Write a prompt that classifies a Lumen support ticket into exactly one of five labels: billing, bug, feature_request, account_access, other. Output only the label — lowercase, no punctuation, no explanation, no preamble.
public.exampleInput: I was charged twice for the October invoice — order LMN-4471 and LMN-4472 are identical. Can you refund the duplicate?
constraintsShown: Must be one of the five labels, lowercase
No explanation, even if the ticket asks for one
gradedOn: Word is one of the five valid labels
The label is correct for the ticket
